1.text: Indirimbo yahimbishijwe ubwenge ya Etani Umunyezerahi.

2.text: Nzaririmba iteka imbabazi z'Uwiteka,Ab'ibihe byose nzabamenyesha umurava wawe n'akanwa kanjye.

3.text: Kuko navuze nti“Imbabazi zizakomezwa iteka,No mu ijuru ubwaho uzahashimangira umurava wawe.”

4.text: “Nasezeranye isezerano n'uwo natoranije,Narahiye Dawidi umugaragu wanjye

5.text: Nti ‘Nzashimangira urubyaro rwawe iteka,Intebe yawe y'ubwami nzayikomeza,Ukageza ibihe byose.’ ”Sela.

6.text: Uwiteka, ijuru rizashima ibitangaza byawe,Umurava wawe uzashimirwa mu iteraniro ry'abera.

7.text: Ni nde wo mu ijuru wagereranywa n'Uwiteka?Ni nde wo mu bana b'Imana uhwanye n'Uwiteka?

8.text: Ni we Mana iteye ubwoba bwinshi mu rukiko rw'abera,Ni iyo gutinywa kurusha abayikikije bose.

9.text: Uwiteka, Mana Nyiringabo,Ni nde munyambaraga uhwanye nawe, Uwiteka?Umurava wawe urakugose impande zose.

10.text: Ni wowe utegeka kwihinduriza kw'inyanja,Iyo umuraba wayo uhagurutse urawutūrisha.

11.text: Ni wowe wamenaguye Rahabu imeze nk'uwishwe,Watatanishije ababisha bawe ukoboko kw'imbaraga zawe.

12.text: Ijuru ni iryawe, isi na yo ni iyawe,Isi n'ibiyuzuye ni wowe wabishimangiye.

13.text: Ikasikazi n'ikusi ni wowe waharemye,I Taboru n'i Herumoni hishimira izina ryawe.

14.text: Ufite ukuboko kw'imbaraga,Ukuboko kwawe kurakomeye,Ukuboko kwawe kw'iburyo gushyizwe hejuru.

15.text: Gukiranuka no guca imanza zitabera ni imfatiro z'intebe yawe,Imbabazi n'umurava birakubanziriza.

16.text: Hahirwa ishyanga rizi ijwi ry'impundu,Uwiteka, rigendera mu mucyo wo mu maso hawe.

17.text: Bishimira izina ryawe umunsi ukīra,Kandi gukiranuka kwawe ni ko kubashyirisha hejuru.

18.text: Kuko uri icyubahiro cy'imbaraga zabo,Imbabazi zawe ni zo zizashyirisha hejuru ihembe ryacu.

19.text: Kuko ingabo idukingira ari Uwiteka,Umwami wacu ari Uwera wa Isirayeli.

20.text: Cya gihe wabwiriye abakunzi bawe mu byo beretswe uti“Mpaye umunyambaraga gufasha kwanjye,Nshyize hejuru uwatoranijwe mu bantu.

21.text: Mbonye Dawidi umugaragu wanjye,Musīze amavuta yanjye yera.

22.text: Ikiganza cyanjye kizajya kibana na we,Ukuboko kwanjye kuzamukomeza.

23.text: Umwanzi we ntazamutungura,Kandi umunyabyaha ntazamugirira nabi.

24.text: Nanjye nzakubita ababisha be bagwe imbere ye,Nzakubita abamwanga.

25.text: Ariko umurava wanjye n'imbabazi zanjye bizabana na we,Kandi izina ryanjye rizashyirisha hejuru ihembe rye.

26.text: Nzashyira inyanja mu ntoki ze,N'inzūzi mu kuboko kwe kw'iburyo.

27.text: Azantakira ati‘Ni wowe Data, Imana yanjye,Igitare cy'agakiza kanjye.’

28.text: Kandi nzamuhindura impfura yanjye,Asumbe abandi bami bo mu isi.

29.text: Nzamubikira imbabazi zanjye iteka ryose,Isezerano ryanjye rizakomera kuri we.

30.text: Kandi nzaramisha urubyaro rwe iteka ryose,Nzaramisha intebe ye y'ubwami nk'iminsi y'ijuru.

31.text: “Niba abana be bazareka amategeko yanjye,Ntibagendere mu byo nategetse,

32.text: Niba bazaca ku mateka yanjye,Ntibitondere amategeko yanjye,

33.text: Ni bwo nzahōrēsha ibicumuro byabo inkoni,No gukiranirwa kwabo nzaguhōrēsha kubakubita.

34.text: Ariko sinzamukuraho rwose imbabazi zanjye,Sinzivuguruza umurava wanjye.

35.text: Sinzica isezerano ryanjye,Sinzahindura ijambo ryavuye mu kanwa kanjye.

37.text: Urubyaro rwe ruzarama iteka,Intebe ye y'ubwami izarama nk'izuba imbere yanjye.

38.text: Izakomezwa iteka ryose nk'ukwezi,Mu ijuru hariho ubihamya wo kwizerwa.”Sela.

39.text: Ariko ubwawe wataye kure uwo wasīze uramureka,Wamugiriye umujinya.

40.text: Wanze urunuka isezerano ry'umugaragu wawe,Wahumanishije ikamba rye kurijugunya hasi.

41.text: Wagushije inkike ze zose,Washenye ibihome bye.

42.text: Abahisi bose baramunyaga,Abaye igitutsi ku baturanyi be.

43.text: Washyize hejuru ukuboko kw'iburyo kw'ababisha be,Wishimishije abanzi be bose.

44.text: Ni koko usubiza inyuma ubugi bw'inkota ye,Kandi ntiwamuhaye guhagarara ashikamye mu ntambara.

45.text: Wamazeho ubwiza bwe,Wajugunye intebe ye y'ubwami hasi

47.text: Uwiteka, uzageza he kwihisha iteka?Umujinya wawe uzageza he kwaka nk'umuriro?

48.text: Ibuka ko ndi uw'igihe gito,Erega abana b'abantu bose wabaremeye ubusa!

49.text: Ni nde uzarama ntapfe,Agakiza ubugingo bwe ukuboko kw'ikuzimu?Sela.

50.text: Mwami, imbabazi zawe za kera ziri he,Warahiye Dawidi ku bw'umurava wawe?

51.text: Mwami, ibuka ibitutsi batuka abagaragu bawe,Uko niyumanganya mu mutima iby'amahanga yose uko ari menshi.

52.text: Uwiteka, ibuka ibitutsi by'abanzi bawe,Batutse intambwe z'uwo wasīze.

53.text: Uwiteka ahimbazwe iteka ryose.Amen kandi Amen.
